segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, so I looked at the usage from the last 60 days. For the analytics module, you’d be at 38 paid seats today, and you mentioned adding finance, so I modeled 45 seats starting June 1.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That sounds right. We have 41 named users now, four more coming in June. I need the invoice to split the module separately from our base subscription, though.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, we can show it as a separate line item on the order form and invoice. Same customer number, same billing contact, just two lines so AP can code it correctly.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. What’s the annual amount on 45 seats?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: At the standard mid-market rate, it’s $28 per seat per month, billed annually. So 45 seats is $15,120 for the first year. The term would co-term to your main agreement ending April 30, 2027, unless you want a separate 12-month term.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Co-term is cleaner. But if we start June 1, are we paying for the full year or the 11 months to match April 30?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Prorated to match April 30. The amount for June 1, 2026 through April 30, 2027 is $13,860. Then it renews with the base subscription on May 1, 2027.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. We also need go-live the week of June 10. Our team is in inventory close the first week, so training before that won’t land.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Makes sense. I can include the target go-live date of June 12 and two admin training sessions during the week of June 10 in the order notes. Implementation is included for this module, no separate services fee.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Send the order form to me and legal at contracts@northlake-example.com. PO will be 78421, and AP needs net 30.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it. I’ll send the order form today with PO 78421 referenced, net 30 terms, 45 seats, prorated amount $13,860, and June 12 target go-live. If it looks good, signature by Friday keeps the June schedule open.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, Friday is doable. I’ll route it internally once it comes through.
